evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth from ~5 ppm (k=21) to 39 ppm (k=26) at constant Ar flow and temperature
Flow steady at ~100 sccm, so rise is not a purge/flow change
Thermocouple holds 750 °C at setpoint with normal heater power
Pressure gauge not installed, so atmosphere integrity cannot be cross-checked

args.missing_evidence: Tube pressure trace (gauge not installed) or an Ar-flow-step/leak-check test to confirm air ingress versus O2 sensor drift; post-run characterization of the film.
